file_id: Tahura Bibi vs Unknown on 11 July, 2024

sentences.text: Tahura Bibi vs Unknown on 11 July, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
11.07.2024
 Sl No. 19
Court No.29
 Tn
(Rejected)
 Crm (A) 2319 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure filed in connection with Kaliachak
 Police Station Case No. 38 of 2024 dated 13.01.2024 under
Sections 498A/323/406/306/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And 
 In the matter of: Tahura Bibi.
 - petitioner.

Ms. Faria Hossain, Ld. App,
 Mr. Samarjit Balial
 ... for the State.

1. 
Considering the materials available in the case diary, the statement of the witness recorded under
Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure which directly implicates the husband and
mother-in-law of the victim, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
2.  Accordingly, this application for anticipatory bail stands rejected.
3. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Sugato Majumdar, J.)
